notes: the same if/else lowering with a false condition: pop_jump_if_falsy jumps directly to the else-branch's first instruction, past both the if-branch and its trailing jump
ADR-0013's full if/else lowering with a true condition: pop_jump_if_falsy falls through into the if-branch, which ends with an unconditional jump past the else-branch
pop_jump_if_falsy pops a true condition and falls through, so the second store overwrites x - the mirror of pop-jump-if-falsy-taken
a non-boolean condition is a TypeMismatchError naming pop_jump_if_falsy and boolean, never a coercion (docs/isa.md section 5)
pop_jump_if_falsy pops the false condition and jumps past the second store, so x keeps its first-assigned value (docs/isa.md section 5, ADR-0013)
an unbound variable's load pushes :undefined, and pop_jump_if_falsy treats :undefined as falsy exactly as jump_if_falsy_or_pop does (docs/isa.md section 5)
